provenance.source_name: U.S. Census TIGER/Line All Lines county edges
provenance.transformation: Select unique ROADFLG topological edges from the CBSA's complete member counties, project to EPSG:32616, and aggregate qualifying MTFCC edge lengths and TNID endpoint degrees.
assumptions: TIGER All Lines contains unique topological edges rather than duplicate named road features.
CBSAs are composed of whole member counties, so no within-county polygon clipping is applied.
Freeway proxy=S1100+S1630; arterial proxy=S1200; local/residual=S1400+S1640+S1730.
Intersections count distinct endpoint TNIDs with degree >=3; nearby qualifying nodes within 20 m are merged; nodes within 5 m of the CBSA boundary are excluded.
All member counties must be present for the CBSA network to be complete.

provenance.source_name: NOAA NCEI Annual Normals Station Inventory
provenance.transformation: Select nearest station within 100 km reporting ANN-SNOW-NORMAL for this feature using great-circle distance.
assumptions: Selected station USW00013876 (BIRMINGHAM AP) is 12.02 km from the CBSA representative point.
The station normal is a proxy for the CBSA, not an area-weighted CBSA measurement.

provenance.transformation: Read ANN-SNOW-NORMAL in inches from the 1991-2020 station normal and convert to millimeters (multiply by 25.4).
assumptions: A NOAA-reported numeric 0.0 is retained as zero; blank or -9999 values mean missing/insufficient data and are not converted to zero.

provenance.transformation: Use published DP03_0025E mean travel time to work in minutes for CBSA 13820.
assumptions: Published ACS 5-year profile estimate is used directly; no imputation or zero substitution.

provenance.source_geography: Published Census CBSA estimates and margins of error
provenance.transformation: Divide B08013_E001 aggregate travel minutes by B08303_E001 workers. Both ACS universes are workers age 16+ who did not work from home.
assumptions: Use the same two tables for every candidate and reference; no profile fallback or imputation.
Input MOEs are retained and checked. They are not a derived confidence interval for the ratio.
The unrounded ratio of published estimates can differ from the rounded DP03 profile mean.

features.label: Annual snowfall
features.definition: 1991–2020 annual snowfall normal; missing is not zero.

features.label: Days at or above 90°F
features.definition: Days with maximum temperature at least 90°F (32.2°C).

features.label: Mean commute
features.definition: Grouped ACS duration estimate; commuting proxy, not measured congestion.

features.label: Road density
features.definition: TIGER road centerline km per CBSA land km².

features.label: Intersection density
features.definition: Consolidated TIGER network junctions per CBSA land km².

features.label: Freeway share
features.definition: Share of included road length classified as freeway or ramp.

features.label: Arterial share
features.definition: Share of included road length classified as secondary roads.

features.label: Local road share
features.definition: Share of included road length classified as local, service, or alley roads.

features.label: Public DC charging
features.definition: Operational public DC ports divided by population times 100,000. Not secured fleet capacity.

features.label: County charging coverage
features.definition: Population share in counties with at least one operational public DC port; not travel-time access.

features.label: Resident population
features.definition: ACS resident population; not observed ride-hailing demand.

features.label: Population density
features.definition: Population divided by CBSA land area excluding water.

features.label: Zero-vehicle households
features.definition: Households without an available vehicle divided by all households.

features.label: Transit commute share
features.definition: Public transit commuters divided by applicable workers; transit also competes with ride-hailing.
